scenes.text: Perimeter task 1: a rectangle is 2 cm long and 3 cm wide. What is its perimeter in cm? Let us think carefully. Add every side: 2 plus 3 plus 2 plus 3 equals 10 cm. The answer is 10. Great work!
Perimeter task 2: a rectangle is 3 cm long and 5 cm wide. What is its perimeter in cm? Let us think carefully. Add every side: 3 plus 5 plus 3 plus 5 equals 16 cm. The answer is 16. Great work!
Perimeter task 3: a rectangle is 4 cm long and 7 cm wide. What is its perimeter in cm? Let us think carefully. Add every side: 4 plus 7 plus 4 plus 7 equals 22 cm. The answer is 22. Great work!
Perimeter task 4: a rectangle is 5 cm long and 9 cm wide. What is its perimeter in cm? Let us think carefully. Add every side: 5 plus 9 plus 5 plus 9 equals 28 cm. The answer is 28. Great work!
